effect_description_eng:
＜Iceclad＞ (Other than against Security Digimon, compare the number of digivolution cards instead of DP in this Digimon's battles.)
[On Play] [When Digivolving] Trash the bottom 2 digivolution cards from 1 of your opponent's Digimon. Then, if your opponent has no Digimon with digivolution cards, gain 1 memory.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [When Attacking] Give 1 of your opponent's Digimon ＜Security A. -1＞ (This Digimon checks 1 additional security card.) until the end of their turn.
